Turner County Fair
The oldest county fair in the state, t he Turner County Fair is a free gate four day fair in August. We pride ourselves on our wide array of 4-H exhibits, specialty food, commercial exhibits, midway, and contests that are sure to delight.
The fair gives local 4-H members the opportunity to showcase their projects while also serving as an unofficial end to summer with four fun-filled days before summer ends and school starts. Learn more from our Extension Office!
